posts.author: HantomPro
posts.body: In my RPG Maker game, i want create a Map,with mechanics like a first fnaf and iron lung games , inside a submarine ,anyone knows a plugin make a 3D camera?

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
First Person? Try this:
Fractalis V2.0 (updated) by Chainer
First Person Shooter, RPG MV, 3D
chainer.itch.io
If you want something different, but that runs smoothly on older computers, I recommend this one:
3D Plugin for RPG Maker MZ and MV (PNDK 3D) by PANDAKO
This plugin allows you to create 3D games with RPG Maker MZ and MV.
pandako.itch.io
